arent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 14),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 62),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "0:00",
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        local barBack = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 4),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -12),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.75,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        corner(barBack, 999)
        FP.Bar = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = barBack,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 526,
        })
        corner(FP.Bar, 999)
        local seekHit = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FP.Full,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -19),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 527,
        })

        local closeBtn = FP.iconButton(FP.Full, "", 24, 0, 0)
        closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
        closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        closeBtn.Text = "×"
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
        closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        closeBtn.TextSize = 15
        local miniBtn = FP.iconButton(FP.Full, "", 24, 0, 0)
        miniBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 8)
        miniBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        miniBtn.Text = "–"
        miniBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
        miniBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        miniBtn.TextSize = 15

        FP.Disc = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "",
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 524,
        })
        corner(FP.Disc, 999)
        FP.Ring.Parent = FP.Disc
        local hole = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FP.Disc,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 525,
        })
        corner(hole, 999)

        bindRowTap(closeBtn, function() setFloatingVisible(false) end)
        bindRowTap(miniBtn, function()
            FP.mini = true
            FP.applyMode()
        end)
        bindRowTap(FP.LikeBtn, function()
            if SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then toggleTrackLike(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) end
        end)
        bindRowTap(prevBtn, previousTrack)
        bindRowTap(FP.PlayBtn, togglePlayback)
        bindRowTap(nextBtn, nextTrack)
        bindRowTap(seekHit, function()
            local sound = SpotifyState.CurrentSound
            local x = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation().X
            if FP.lastPointer then x = FP.lastPointer.X end
            if sound and sound.TimeLength and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
                local pct = clamp((x - barBack.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, barBack.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
                pcall(function()
                    sound.TimePosition = pct * sound.TimeLength
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = sound.TimePosition
                end)
                refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
            end
        end)
        track(seekHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            FP.lastPointer = input.Position
        end))

        local dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = nil, nil, nil, false
        track(FP.Drag.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = input, input.Position, FloatingPlayer.Position, false
                SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = true
            end
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragInput or not dragStart then return end
            if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if not moved and delta.Magnitude < 6 then return end
            moved = true
            local screen = Window.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
            local size = FloatingPlayer.AbsoluteSize
            local x = startPos.X.Offset + delta.X
            local y = startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            local baseX = startPos.X.Scale * screen.X
            local baseY = startPos.Y.Scale * screen.Y
            x = clamp(x, -baseX, screen.X - baseX - size.X)
            y = clamp(y, -baseY, screen.Y - baseY - size.Y)
            FloatingPlayer.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, x, startPos.Y.Scale, y)
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragInput then return end
            if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
            if not moved and FP.mini then
                FP.mini = false
                FP.applyMode()
            end
            dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = nil, nil, nil, false
            task.defer(function() SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = false end)
        end))

        task.spawn(function()
            while FloatingPlayer and FloatingPlayer.Parent do
                if FP.mini and SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                    FP.rotation = (FP.rotation + 2) % 360
                    FP.Disc.Rotation = FP.rotation
                end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)

        FP.lastCover = nil
        FP.applyMode()
    end

    refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu = function()
        PM.Panel.Visible = SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible == true
        if not PM.Panel.Visible then return end
        local available = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.Y - 46
        local content = PM.BodyLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 24 + 49
        local cardW = NowPlayingCard.AbsoluteSize.X
        local width = (cardW > 0) and math.min(PM.WIDTH, cardW - 24) or PM.WIDTH
        PM.Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, math.floor(math.max(160, math.min(content, available > 0 and available or content))))
        local volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume
        PM.VolumeValue.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(volume * 100 + 0.5))
        PM.VolumeFill.Size = UDim2.new(volume, 0, 1, 0)
        PM.VolumeKnob.Position = UDim2.new(volume, 0, 0.5, 0)
        PM.SpeedValue.Text = string.format("%.2fx", SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed)
        for _, chip in ipairs(PM.chips) do
            PM.paintChip(chip.Button, math.abs(chip.Value - SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed) < 0.001)
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(PM.switches) do
            PM.paintSwitch(entry)
        end
        local left = PM.timerLeft()
        PM.TimerValue.Text = left and secondsToClock(left) or "Apagado"
        for _, chip in ipairs(PM.timerChips) do
            PM.paintChip(chip.Button, (SpotifyState.SleepMinutes or 0) == chip.Value and (chip.Value == 0 or left ~= nil))
        end
    end

    PM.switch(4, "Repetir canción", function() return SpotifyState.IsRepeat end, PM.setRepeat)
    PM.switch(5, "Aleatorio", function() return SpotifyState.Shuffle end, function(v)
        SpotifyState.Shuffle = v == true
        if SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged then pcall(SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged) end
    end)
    PM.switch(6, "Reproductor flotante", function() return SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible end, function(v)
        if v and (not FloatingPlayer or not FloatingPlayer.Parent) then createFloatingPlayer() end
        setFloatingVisible(v)
    end)

    refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer = function()
        if not FloatingPlayer or not FloatingPlayer.Parent then return end
        FloatingPlayer.Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible == true
        local currentTrack = SpotifyState.CurrentTrack or SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex]
        if not currentTrack then return end
        local cover = resolveTrackCoverImage(currentTrack) or ""
        if cover ~= FP.lastCover then
            FP.lastCover = cover
            FP.Cover.Image = cover
            FP.Disc.Image = cover
            FP.Backdrop.Image = cover
            FP.Fallback.Visible = trim(cover) == ""
        end
        FP.Title.Text = currentTrack.Name or "Selecciona una canción"
        FP.Artist.Text = currentTrack.Artist or "Spotify"
        local current = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0) or 0
        local total = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength) or durationToSeconds(currentTrack.Duration)
        total = math.max(total or 0, 1)
        FP.Bar.Size = UDim2.new(clamp(current / total, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
        FP.Time.Text = secondsToClock(current) .. " / " .. (currentTrack.Duration or secondsToClock(total))
        FP.PlayIcon.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
        local liked = isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        FP.LikeIcon.Image = asset(116559368303288)
        FP.LikeIcon.ImageColor3 = liked and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    local function openPlaybackMenu()
        SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible = true
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        PM.Scale.Scale = 0.94
        TweenService:Create(PM.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        task.defer(refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu)
    end
    bindRowTap(SettingsClose, function() SpotifyState.SettingsMenuVisible = false; refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu() end)
    MoreTopBtn.Activated:Connect(openPlaybackMenu)
    MoreBtn.Activated:Connect(openPlaybackMenu)
    refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()


    createFavoritesTile = function(layoutOrder)
        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.cardHeight
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, spotifyLogicalSize(SongList).X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.max(42, cellW - 20)
        coverSize = math.floor(math.min(coverSize, m.coverMax))

        local Card = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = SongList,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 38, 160),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Card.Name = "SpotifyFavoritesTile"
        corner(Card, 12)

        local Glow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 90, 235), BackgroundTransparency = 0.72,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        corner(Glow, 12)

        local Heart = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize * 0.42), math.floor(coverSize * 0.42)),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(coverSize * 0.21), 0, coverPad + math.floor(coverSize * 0.20)),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = asset(116559368303288),
            ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = 14,
        })

        local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 22),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -48), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Favoritos", "Favorites"), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = m.compact and 13 or 15,
            TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        Title:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Favoritos")
        Title:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Favorites")

        local Subtitle = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -27), BackgroundTransparency = 1,

            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 210, 245), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        Subtitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Tus canciones favoritas")
        Subtitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Your favorite songs")

        local TapArea = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Card, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16,
        })
        TapArea.Name = "FavoritesTapArea"
        bindRowTap(TapArea, function()
            FavPage.show()
        end)
        TapArea.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(112, 46, 184)}):Play()
        end)
        TapArea.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 38, 160)}):Play()
        end)
        return Card
    end

    FavPage.HEART_ON = asset(116559368303288)
    FavPage.HEART_OFF = asset(116559368303288)
    FavPage.PLAY = asset(135609604299893)
    FavPage.PAUSE = asset(74873705394436)
    FavPage.SEARCH = asset(121018724060431)
    FavPage.HERO_H = 196
    FavPage.covers = {}
    FavPage.rows = {}
    FavPage.history = {}
    FavPage.signature = nil
    FavPage.open = false
    FavPage.query = ""

    FavPage.text = function(label, es, en)
        label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
        label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        label.Text = GetText(es, en)
    end

    FavPage.tween = function(obj, t, props)
        TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
    end

    FavPage.likedList = function()
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
            if isLiked(i) then
                list[#list + 1] = i
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    FavPage.randomFrom = function(list, exclude)
        if #list == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        if #list == 1 then
            return list[1]
        end
        local pick = exclude
        local guard = 0
        while pick == exclude and guard < 20 do
            pick = list[math.random(1, #list)]
            guard = guard + 1
        end
        return pick
    end

    FavPage.neighbor = function(fromIndex, dir)
        local list
        if SpotifyState.FavQueue then
            list = FavPage.likedList()
        elseif SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            list = {}
            for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
                list[i] = i
            end
        else
            return nil
        end
        if #list == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        if SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            if dir < 0 then
                local back = table.remove(FavPage.history)
                if back and SpotifyState.Catalog[back] then
                    return back
                end
            else
                FavPage.remember(fromIndex)
            end
            return FavPage.randomFrom(list, fromIndex)
        end
        local pos = nil
        for p, idx in ipairs(list) do
            if idx == fromIndex then
                pos = p
                break
            end
        end
        if not pos then
            return list[dir > 0 and 1 or #list]
        end
        pos = pos + dir
        if pos > #list then pos = 1 end
        if pos < 1 then pos = #list end
        return list[pos]
    end

    FavPage.remember = function(index)
        if index and SpotifyState.Catalog[index] then
            table.insert(FavPage.history, index)
            if #FavPage.history > 50 then
                table.remove(FavPage.history, 1)
            end
        end
    end

    FavPage.play = function(index)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentTrack and SpotifyState.SelectedIndex ~= index then
            FavPage.remember(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
        SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
        playTrack(index)
    end

    FavPage.totalText = function(list)
        local seconds = 0
        for _, index in ipairs(list) do
            local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if song then
                seconds = seconds + durationToSeconds(song.Duration)
            end
        end
        local minutes = math.max(1, math.floor(seconds / 60 + 0.5))
        if minutes >= 60 then
            local h, m = math.floor(minutes / 60), minutes % 60
            return string.format("%d h %d min", h, m), string.format("%d hr %d min", h, m)
        end
        return string.format("%d min", minutes), string.format("%d min", minutes)
    end

        Parent = CatalogPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -90),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),

    FavPage.layout = function()
        local w = FavPage.Root.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local narrow = w < 520
        local cover = narrow and 104 or 136
        FavPage.Cover.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cover, cover)
        FavPage.Info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20 + cover + 16, 1, -18)
        FavPage.Info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(20 + cover + 16 + 16), 0, cover)
        FavPage.Title.TextSize = narrow and 22 or (w < 760 and 30 or 38)
        FavPage.Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(40, cover - 64))
        FavPage.Kind.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, narrow and 2 or 14)
        FavPage.SearchBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 140 or 210, 32)
        FavPage.HeadTime.Visible = not narrow
    end
    FavPage.Root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(FavPage.layout)

    FavPage.Scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
        local y = FavPage.Scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        local solid = y > FavPage.HERO_H - 40
        FavPage.TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = solid and 0 or math.clamp(1 - (y / (FavPage.HERO_H - 40)), 0, 1)
        FavPage.MiniPlay.Visible = solid and FavPage.PlayAll.Visible
        FavPage.MiniTitle.Visible = solid
    end)

    FavPage.isCurrent = function(index)
        return SpotifyState.CurrentTrack ~= nil and SpotifyState.SelectedIndex == index
    end

    FavPage.paintRow = function(row)
        local current = FavPage.isCurrent(row.Index)
        local playing = current and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil
        row.Title.TextColor3 = current and spotifyGreen or spotifyText
        row.Number.TextColor3 = current and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179)
        row.Number.Visible = not playing and not row.Hover
        row.Bars.Visible = playing and not row.Hover
        row.HoverIcon.Visible = row.Hover == true
        row.HoverIcon.Image = playing and FavPage.PAUSE or FavPage.PLAY
    end

    FavPage.paint = function()
        for _, row in ipairs(FavPage.rows) do
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end
        local playingFav = SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        FavPage.PlayIcon.Image = playingFav and FavPage.PAUSE or FavPage.PLAY
        FavPage.MiniIcon.Image = FavPage.PlayIcon.Image
        local shuffle = SpotifyState.Shuffle == true
        FavPage.ShuffleBtn.TextColor3 = shuffle and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179)
        FavPage.ShuffleDot.Visible = shuffle
    end

    FavPage.toggleRow = function(index)
        if FavPage.isCurrent(index) and SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
            togglePlayback()
        else
            FavPage.play(index)
        end
    end

    FavPage.makeRow = function(index, position)
        local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not song then
            return
        end
        local Row = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FavPage.Body,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = position,
            ZIndex = 42,
        })
        corner(Row, 6)

        local Number = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 58),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = tostring(position),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local HoverIcon = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, -7),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FavPage.PLAY,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local Bars = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, -7),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local bars = {}
        for b = 1, 3 do
            local bar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Bars,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, (b - 1) * 5, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 44,
            })
            bars[b] = bar
        end

        local Cover = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0.5, -21),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = FavPage.covers[index] or "",
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        corner(Cover, 4)
        if not FavPage.covers[index] then
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, img = pcall(resolveTrackCoverImage, song)
                if ok and type(img) == "string" and img ~= "" then
                    FavPage.covers[index] = img
                    if Cover.Parent then
                        Cover.Image = img
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Name,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextColor3 = spotifyText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Artist,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local Heart = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -126, 0.5, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 45,
        })
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Heart,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FavPage.HEART_ON,
            ImageColor3 = spotifyGreen,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 46,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
